findings_qualitative.value: All CO emission lies kpc away from the nucleus in two clumps with a diffuse envelope along an X-ray plume

evidence.quote: All of the CO line emission, originating from a $10^{10}\,M_{\odot}$ molecular gas reservoir, is located several kpc away from the nucleus of the central galaxy.

claims.hypothesis: Stimulated cooling by cavity uplift formed the molecular gas
claims.experiment: Compare mass of ICM displaced by the X-ray cavity to molecular mass
claims.result: Displaced 2.4e8 Msun, about 40 times smaller than molecular gas mass
claims.finding: Cavity uplift can lift only a few percent of the gas

evidence.quote: Only a few percent of the total molecular gas mass could have been uplifted by the cavity.

claims.hypothesis: Sloshing induced by a nearby galaxy triggered condensation
claims.experiment: Compare offsets of X-ray peak, BCG, molecular gas and nearby galaxy
claims.result: Mutual offsets and coincidence with X-ray plume
claims.finding: Sloshing is argued to be the mechanism

evidence.quote: We therefore argue that sloshing is the mechanism responsible for triggering condensation in RXJ0821.

claims.hypothesis: A merger donated or displaced the gas
claims.experiment: Estimate gas masses of the nearby galaxy and velocities
claims.result: Insufficient gas and low relative velocity

evidence.quote: Overall the possibility that the cold gas has been either deposited or dislodged by a merger is not well-motivated by the observational data.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Merger donation/displacement and cavity uplift rejected

evidence.quote: While uplift behind X-ray cavities is a promising cold gas formation mechanism in other BCGs, it fails here.

limitations_admitted.value: Cavity is putative; no radio image

evidence.quote: Without an image of the radio source we cannot conclusively determine if this feature is an X-ray cavity.
However, significant systematic uncertainties were unavoidable in the V17 analysis.
